reconcile.note: Clarke attributes Mary's failure to recognize Jesus to her grief and complete lack of expectation that a resurrection was even possible.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Bart D. Ehrman catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.

sides.snippet: They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
sides.verseText: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, \"Rejoice!\" They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

sides.snippet: saw Jesus standing, and didn't know that it was Jesus.
sides.verseText: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn't know that it was Jesus.
